summary: Pre-release Service Desk verification: PM frequency extension, Master Admin customers console, and Lifecycle 404-not-500. All 10 backend tests PASS and frontend PM dropdown shows the exact 6 expected options in the required order.

issues: Frequency uses native <select> (not shadcn Select) — inconsistent with design system but functionally correct.
'Next PM date' and 'Previous PM' fields use browser-native date pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar component.
Modal has only a Cancel button visible — no Save/Schedule submit button until an equipment is chosen (verify this is intentional gating vs. missing button).

action_items: Optional: replace native select/date inputs in Schedule PM modal with shadcn equivalents for consistency.
Verify Schedule PM submit button behaviour when Equipment is chosen (out of scope for this pre-release check).
critical_code_review_comments: PM frequency validation (_canon_freq) correctly accepts weekly/fortnightly/monthly/quarterly/biannual/annual and rejects 'daily' with 400 including 'frequency' error message.
Master Admin service-desk customers endpoint enforces role check (403 for non-master) and returns all 5 seeded SDDEMO_ orgs with summary.total>=5.
Lifecycle endpoint correctly returns 404 (not 500) for cases not owned by requesting org — org isolation is enforced.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_svc_pm_and_master.py covers PM frequency validation, Master Admin customer console (both admin 200 and owner 403), and Lifecycle 404-for-non-owner. Run via `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_svc_pm_and_master.py -v`. Frontend PM dropdown verified via data-testid=pm-frequency-select — options came back exactly ['Weekly','Fortnightly','Monthly','Quarterly','6-monthly','Annual']. Landing page requires clicking a 'Sign in' button to open a login modal; email input has no type=email, use placeholder selector.
